Title: Secure Credential Storage and Retrieval
Description: Securely stores and retrieves service credentials using Fernet encryption

Title: Password Hashing and Verification
Description: Creates and verifies secure password hashes using PBKDF2 with SHA-256 and random salt
Required Inputs: password (text) for hashing, stored_hash (text) and password (text) for verification
Outputs: text (hashed password) for hashing, boolean (valid/invalid) for verification

Title: Session Creation and Management
Description: Creates and manages authenticated sessions with automatic expiration
Outputs: session token (text) if successful, None if failed

Title: Credential Removal
Description: Safely removes stored credentials from the encrypted storage

Title: Session Validation and Expiration
Description: Validates session tokens and handles automatic expiration after 24 hours
Outputs: tuple: boolean (valid/invalid), session info dictionary (if valid) or None (if invalid)

Title: Encrypted Storage Management
Description: Manages encrypted file storage for credentials using Fernet symmetric encryption
